description: Add or update shares for a dashboard for the given users and groups.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard to which the shares will be applied.

shares.description: A list of share entries. Each entry must contain: - ``name`` (str): The username (email) or group name. - ``type`` (str): Either ``"user"`` or ``"group"``. - ``rule`` (str): The access level (for example ``"view"`` or ``"edit"``). The ``name`` is resolved to ``shareId`` internally; entries that cannot be resolved are skipped.

examples.user_query: Give john.doe@example.com and the 'sales-team' group view access to dashboard 63f2c9e4b8a4e2001d3f9a23.
examples.notes: This call adds view access for a user and a group to the specified dashboard. Use this when you want to share a dashboard with new users or groups.

examples.user_query: I need to update a user's access level on a dashboard from view to edit. How can I do that?
examples.notes: This call updates the access level for a specific user on the given dashboard. Use this when you need to modify an existing share's permissions.

examples.user_query: How do I share a dashboard with multiple users and groups, giving some edit access and others view access?
examples.notes: This call shares the dashboard with multiple users and groups, assigning different access levels. Use this when you need to set up complex sharing rules for a dashboard.

description: Transfer ownership of a dashboard to a different user.

dashboard_id.description: The ``oid`` of the dashboard whose owner will be changed.

new_owner_id.description: The Sisense user ID (``_id``) of the user who will become the new owner.

admin_access.description: When ``True`` (default), appends ``?adminAccess=true`` to the request. Required when the API token user is not the current dashboard owner. Pass ``False`` when restoring ownership back to the original owner (the caller is already the temporary owner at that point).

original_owner_rule.description: The share rule assigned to the outgoing owner after the transfer. Defaults to ``"edit"``.

examples.user_query: Transfer ownership of dashboard 'sales_dashboard_2023' to user 'new_owner_123', and set the original owner's access to 'view'.
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'sales_dashboard_2023' dashboard to the user with ID 'new_owner_123'. The original owner will retain 'view' access to the dashboard.

examples.user_query: How can I assign the 'marketing_dashboard' to user 'user_456' while keeping admin access enabled?
examples.notes: This call transfers ownership of the 'marketing_dashboard' to the user with ID 'user_456'. Admin access is explicitly enabled for the API token user to ensure the transfer succeeds.

examples.user_query: Can I restore ownership of 'finance_dashboard' back to its original owner?
examples.notes: This call restores ownership of the 'finance_dashboard' to its original owner with ID 'original_owner_789'. Admin access is disabled since the caller is already the temporary owner.

description: Retrieve share details (users and groups) for a dashboard by title.

dashboard_name.description: Title of the dashboard to retrieve share information for.

examples.user_query: Show who has access to the 'Sales Overview' dashboard.
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'Sales Overview' dashboard, including users and groups with access.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the sharing settings for the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard?
examples.notes: This call fetches the sharing information for the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard, listing all users and groups with access.

examples.user_query: I need to check who can view the 'Executive Summary' dashboard.
examples.notes: Use this to get a list of users and groups that have access to the 'Executive Summary' dashboard.

description: Retrieve share details for a dashboard using the v1 shares endpoint.

admin_access.description: When ``True`` (default), request with ``adminAccess=true``. Some Sisense versions reject the ``adminAccess`` query parameter with HTTP 422 (strict query-schema validation); the request is then retried automatically without it.

examples.user_query: Show who has access to dashboard 5f7d3a2b8e4b0c0012345678, using admin access.
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'Sales Performance' dashboard, including users and groups with access. Admin access is enabled to include all relevant details.

examples.user_query: Can you show me the share settings for the marketing overview dashboard without admin access?
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'Marketing Overview' dashboard, but without admin access, so the response may exclude some administrative details.

examples.user_query: I need to verify the sharing configuration for the executive summary dashboard.
examples.notes: This retrieves the share details for the 'Executive Summary' dashboard with admin access enabled, ensuring all sharing configurations are visible.
